comparison.objective: Configure a date stamp from a work order and make one correct permanent impression.
comparison.physical_skill: Read a date, rotate two detented wheels, ink, orient and press the stamp, then return it.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one correctly dated, upright, unsmeared, untilted impression is made in the box and the stamp is returned.
comparison.reason: Configure-then-apply is generic overlap; the tested ability is permanent print production, not captive-fastener manipulation and measured damper commissioning.
